blocks.Text:
Business travel rose 18% year on year to 165.0 tCO2e. Demo Harbour Components recorded the increase because customer site visits resumed.

Total energy consumption fell 3% year on year to 1.98 GWh. Other environmental indicators remained within the materiality threshold.

Demo Harbour Components commits to reducing the environmental footprint of its plants and offices, to buying more of its electricity from renewable sources, and to managing waste and water with care. Each site reviews its environmental performance every year and reports it openly to its stakeholders.
Business travel emissions rose 18% year on year to 165.0 tCO2e. Demo Harbour Components reported the increase because customer site visits resumed in 2025 compared with 2024.
Other environmental indicators remained within the materiality threshold.

Demo Harbour Components commits to reducing the environmental footprint of its plants and offices, to buying more of its electricity from renewable sources, and to managing waste and water with care. Each site reviews its environmental performance every year and reports it openly to its stakeholders.

Female annual training hours increased 16% year on year to 25.5 hours. Demo Harbour Components reported the increase because additional compliance training increased training hours in 2025 compared with 2024.
Other social indicators remained within the materiality threshold.

Demo Harbour Components treats every employee fairly, protects health and safety at all of its sites, and offers equal opportunities in hiring, training and promotion. We invest in the skills of our people and listen to their views through regular dialogue with employee representatives.
